name: hardened-loop
post_title: Loop Engineering Examples: Harden One Loop, Control by Control
description: A drop-in loop.sh for unattended claude -p runs with an iteration cap, per-call turn and budget caps, a cumulative spend ceiling, a features.json exit that only a read-only test gate can flip, a 3-strike unchanged-diff breaker, and a kill trap that writes the progress note; every exit names the control that fired
